description: Returns all proxies owned by the authenticated user with full connection details (host, port, login, password, geo, operator, expiration). Use this first when the user asks anything about "my proxies", to find a specific proxy, or to get a proxy_id needed for other tools. Supports filtering by type (mobile/server/backconnect/residential) and id_country (numeric ID — use get_country_list to resolve from ISO codes; that tool lands in v0.2). The server already drops expired proxies, but active_only rechecks client-side as a safety net.

id_country.description: Filter by numeric country ID (not ISO code)

name: list_proxies
title: List my proxies
